hero.headline: Book a call, order at fixed prices, deliver under your brand.
hero.sub: A productized workflow built for agency owners who need reliable execution without the coordination overhead. No quotes to chase, no vendors to manage, no surprises.

journey.headline: What happens, and when.
journey.sub: From your first order to white-label delivery, every engagement follows the same simple rhythm. You always know exactly where things stand.

phases.label: Join
phases.title: Book your 30-minute partner call
phases.description: Start with a 30-minute partner call. We map your fulfillment and set up your account on the call. No commitment and no card.

steps.title: Book your partner call
steps.body: Create your free account and you are in. Full portal access, the entire service catalog, and standard fixed pricing from the first minute.

steps.title: Browse the catalog
steps.body: Every service is productized with a fixed scope, a fixed price, and a clear SLA. No ambiguous retainers, no hourly rates to decode.

steps.title: Grab the partner resource library
steps.body: Service descriptions and deliverable samples you can use to sell the work to your own clients before you ever place an order.

phases.label: Order
phases.title: Order any service in one click
phases.description: Pick a service, confirm the scope, and place the order. Fixed price, clear SLA, instant acknowledgment. No back-and-forth quotes.

steps.title: One-click ordering
steps.body: Choose the service and scope from the catalog and order it on the spot. You see the price and SLA before you confirm.

steps.title: Instant acknowledgment
steps.body: Every order gets an automated acknowledgment and a ticket you can track, so nothing ever falls through the cracks.

steps.title: Your account manager on Standard and up
steps.body: From the Standard tier, a named account manager who knows your business and clients drives the order for you, over Slack or WhatsApp.

phases.label: Produce
phases.title: Our in-house team builds it
phases.description: You stay in control without doing the work. Track every order in the portal, with priority production and expedited SLAs as you move up the tiers.

steps.title: Built by specialists, in-house
steps.body: Your order goes to a specialist team that has run fulfillment since 2019, not a rotating cast of freelancers.

steps.title: Status in the portal
steps.body: Follow each order from queued to delivered in the portal, with order-level status updates. No chasing required.

steps.title: Priority as you scale
steps.body: Standard jumps the queue over Free. VIP gets front-of-queue production, roughly 20 to 30% faster, plus unlimited revision rounds.

phases.label: Deliver
phases.title: White-label delivery, ready to present
phases.description: Every deliverable ships 100% white-label with full commercial rights, in a format that makes you look good. Your client only ever sees you.

steps.title: 100% white-label packaging
steps.body: Files, reports, and deliverables carry your brand. Nothing leaves our side with growX branding unless you specifically ask for it.

steps.title: We can run client comms, as you
steps.body: On the VIP tier, our white-label client project manager talks to your end clients under your brand, from requirements to revisions to updates.

steps.title: Full commercial rights
steps.body: Everything we deliver is yours to keep, resell, and build on. Your pricing and your client relationship stay entirely your own.

communication.headline: You're always in the loop.
communication.sub: Every tier gets a clear communication rhythm that keeps you informed without pulling you into the weeds. You know what is happening without having to ask.

channels.name: Partner Portal
channels.description: Order, track, and manage everything in one place. Order-level status updates, ticket history, and one-click reordering across the catalog.

channels.name: Account Manager
channels.description: From Standard, a named account manager on a direct Slack or WhatsApp channel who knows your business, clients, and history.

channels.name: Pipeline Call
channels.description: A monthly call from the Standard tier to review active projects, upcoming needs, and capacity planning for the month ahead.

channels.name: Strategy Session
channels.description: On VIP, a quarterly growth session with senior leadership: offer packaging, retainer pricing, and what to sell next.

cadence.action: Instant acknowledgment plus order-level status in the portal
4 hours on Free, 2 hours on Standard, 1 hour on VIP
Pipeline call: active work, upcoming needs, capacity
VIP growth strategy session with senior leadership

yourPart.headline: Three inputs. That's all we need from you.
yourPart.sub: You stay in your zone of genius. The production, coordination, and project management are ours. Here is the entire ask on your end.

steps.title: Send a short brief
steps.description: A short brief and your client's brand assets. That is the whole input. We handle scoping, strategy, scripting, and production from there.

steps.title: Share access where it's needed
steps.description: For build and operations work, grant access to the platform the job runs on, such as GoHighLevel, a CRM, or an ad account. You stay the account owner throughout.

steps.title: Approve before it ships
steps.description: You review and sign off before anything reaches your client. Nothing goes live without your approval. You are always the last checkpoint.

quality.headline: You forward the work. You don't fix it first.
quality.sub: The point of a fulfillment partner is that the output is client-ready, not a first draft you have to clean up. Here is what stands behind every deliverable.

items.title: QA before you ever see it
items.description: Every order runs through internal QA before it reaches you, so what lands in your inbox is ready to forward under your brand, not a rough cut to review.

items.title: Revisions until it's right
items.description: Structured revision rounds on every deliverable, staged at natural checkpoints like script, draft, and final, so feedback is focused rather than open-ended. Unlimited rounds on VIP.

items.title: You approve before your client does
items.description: Nothing reaches your client without your sign-off. You see status the whole way through in the portal, and you decide when a deliverable is ready to hand over.

items.title: If it's off, we make it right
items.description: Miss the mark and we fix it. The partnership is built on repeat delivery, not one-off orders, so getting it right is how we keep your business, not an exception.

whiteLabel.headline: We stay invisible. You take the credit.
whiteLabel.sub: Every deliverable ships under your brand with full commercial rights. By default your client never knows we exist, and on VIP we speak to them as your team.

promises.title: Invisible by default, your team on VIP
promises.description: On Free and Standard we never touch your clients. On VIP, our white-label client project manager talks to them under your brand, as your team, never as growX.

promises.title: Everything leaves under your brand
promises.description: Files, reports, and handoff docs carry your logo and agency name. Nothing leaves our side with growX branding unless you specifically ask for it.

promises.title: Your pricing is your business
promises.description: Our fixed prices are your cost. What you charge your client is entirely your decision. We never know, and it is not our place to.

promises.title: Full commercial rights, always
promises.description: Every deliverable is 100% white-label with full commercial rights. Yours to keep, resell, and build on, with no strings attached.

promises.title: NDAs available on request
promises.description: If your agency or your client requires a non-disclosure agreement, we sign. Standard mutual NDA, returned within a business day, no legal wrangling.

promises.title: We escalate to you, never around you
promises.description: If an order needs a client decision, we flag it to you with a recommended path forward. You make the call. We execute it.

faq.sub: Everything worth knowing before you place your first white-label order.

items.question: How quickly can I start?
items.answer: Fast. Book a partner call, and we set up your account on the call itself, so you can place your first order the same day. There is no onboarding fee and no card required to join.

items.question: Can I cancel or downgrade a tier?
items.answer: Yes. Standard and VIP run month-to-month with no lock-in. Downgrade or cancel anytime and you drop back to the Free tier, keeping full portal access and standard pricing.

items.question: How does ordering actually work?
items.answer: Pick a service from the catalog, confirm the scope, and place the order in one click. You see the fixed price and SLA up front. From Standard, your account manager can place and manage orders for you.

items.question: Do I get a single point of contact?
items.answer: From the Standard tier, yes: one named account manager who knows your business, fields your Slack or WhatsApp messages, and runs your monthly pipeline call. On Free, support answers within 4 business hours.

items.question: How are revisions handled?
items.answer: Every service includes revision rounds within its defined scope and SLA. On the VIP tier, revision rounds are unlimited on all deliverables, so you can iterate until your client signs off.

items.question: What if a deadline is at risk?
items.answer: We flag it before it happens, not after. If an order is at risk of missing its SLA, you will know in advance with a revised timeline and a clear reason. We do not hide delays.
